entities.summary: Tohpati (b. 1971-07-25, Jakarta) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Jakarta and Indonesia. Known in the fields of indonesia, composers & musicians, asia.
